title: Ulyana and the Recipe
author: K. M. Amberdale
blurb: Ivo Amberdale, the only out kid in a town of nine hundred, stays under the radar: head down, grades up, locker shut. But when a group chat starts predicting things that haven't happened yet, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must expose what the school board buried, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
